evidence: A local WBM v2 manually approved GitHub artifact ZIP reviewer used to check zip_path.stat().st_size <= 512 KiB and then call unbounded Path.read_bytes(). A concurrent replacement/growth between the two steps could allocate arbitrarily more memory even when verification ultimately failed. Introduced a bounded snapshot reader with read(MAX_ZIP_BYTES+1) rejecting the actual byte count before digest, while still parsing that exact hashed snapshot with ZipFile(BytesIO(...)). Both earlier path-swap regressions continue to verify identity binding. New no-network tests replace a ZIP with an enlarged version at file open after stat and refuse any Path.read_bytes use for verification.
limitations: This is an offline artifact memory-budget consistency guard and does not cryptographically sign GitHub runs or prove original WBM source recomputation.
No original 256963-row WBM profile has run; a real archive has not yet been verified.
No original MPTrj large source transfer, Kaggle computation, actual MACE-MPA-0 training-selection attestation, or unseen-generalization claim.
